name: data-and-analytics
description: Perform data analysis, profiling, correlations, outliers detection, and group performance checks on CSV datasets.
prompt: Use this skill to analyze CSV datasets (like StudentsPerformance.csv). Map the user's specific request to one of the targeted tools (summary, correlations, group_analysis, outliers).

tools.name: summary
tools.description: Get descriptive statistics, dimensions, missing value counts, and categorical column overview.

tools.name: correlations
tools.description: Calculate correlation matrix between numeric columns in the dataset.

tools.name: group_analysis
tools.description: Compute mean, standard deviation, min, max of numeric score columns grouped by categorical columns (requires GROUP_BY and SCORE_COL).

tools.name: outliers
tools.description: Detect outliers in numerical score columns using the IQR method.
